narr: Heavy showers and thunderstorms ahead of a cold front led to flash flooding for portions of Washington County in Maryland.
ev: Greencastle Pike near Pinehill Drive had high water flowing over the roadway.
Garden View Road near Troupe Run was closed due to high flowing water over the road.
Broadfording Road was closed near McDade Road due to high water flowing across the highway.
lsr: Greencastle Pike near Pinehill Drive has high water flowing over the roadway near Rush Run.
